fusions.name: Stripping Cloud
fusions.desc: Looses 6 stingers in a wide spread, each dealing 2 damage. 20% of the damage it deals comes back as healing over the following 5 seconds, rather than at once.

fusions.name: Clean Sweep
fusions.desc: Hurls a stinger that deals 28 damage and bursts where it lands, dealing 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Ravening Horde
fusions.desc: Calls a swarm that fights beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 3 damage every second. You regain 4 health for each kill it makes.

fusions.name: Fat of the Land
fusions.desc: Every kill builds a stack on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you deal 4% more damage per stack (22% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
